audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror audit: rows 0, 3 and 4 read Wukong/Sion/Wukong instead of Skill, and row 5 read Sion instead of Wukong. whys[0] ('Level 1 is even') and whys[3] ('Levels 4-5 flatten') already said Skill.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Sion, Skill, Skill, Wukong, Sion]; the mirror audit records 'Rows 0, 3, 4 set to Skill and row 5 set to Wukong in both layers'.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 to Skill and row 5 to Wukong in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match and whys[4] rewritten so it no longer claims a Wukong spike at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sion's spikes carried no numbers; 'it's a long cooldown' was the closest the page got to one, and Decimating Smash is actually 10s at rank 1 — not long at all.
audit.why: Kit: Decimating Smash (Q) 10/9/8/7/6s, Soul Furnace (W) 15/14/13/12/11s with a 3-second detonate, Roar of the Slayer (E) 12/11/10/9/8s at 800 range, Unstoppable Onslaught (R) 140/100/60s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns in the cooldown block, the levels-4-5 row and the level-6 row; first item now correctly reads as Wukong's window because Black Cleaver lands before Sion's tank items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three gaps. (1) 'Charged = knockup' never said that a SHORT release is damage only — the page treated every Q as a stun, which makes players give up trades for free. (2) Roar of the Slayer reduces YOUR armour, which is why sitting in melee after eating it is so costly; never stated. (3) Soul Furnace detonates 3 seconds after the shield, so the danger is timed, not constant.
audit.why: Riot text — Q: 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.' E: 'damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit.' W: 'shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage.' R: 'He can steer his charge slightly... knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.'
audit.corrected: Short-charge versus long-charge distinction, the armour shred on his E, the 3-second Soul Furnace detonation, and the fact that his R gets stronger the further it runs so you sidestep late.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Sion contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even: his uncharged Decimating Smash is easy to sidestep, but a full charge knocks you up and stuns.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Decimating Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even here: Decimating Smash is 10s at rank 1 and Roar of the Slayer 12s, so trade in the gap and never while his E slow is on you.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sion's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught is 140s at rank 1 and steers as it charges — sidestep late, and the longer it runs the harder the knockup.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Decimating Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver lands before his tank items — force the fight while Decimating Smash sits at 10s.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1 — only a long charge knocks up and stuns. - Roar of the Slayer: 12s, 800 range, and it shreds your armour. - Soul Furnace: 15s shield that detonates after 3 seconds.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a long charge stuns; a quick release is damage you can walk through.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace detonates 3 seconds after he shields up — leave first.

edits.before: Track Sion's Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged = knockup. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Only his long charge stuns; Roar of the Slayer shreds armour at 800 range. Trade in the 10s gap.

edits.before: At 6 your Cyclone all-in beats his ult, which is engage-only, so you spike here.
edits.after: At 6 it stays even: his R is engage-only, but Soul Furnace shields your burst.

notes: spikes[3].text claims 'your R knockup interrupts his charging Q'. Riot's description does not state that a knockup cancels the Decimating Smash charge and needsResearch is empty, so I left the sentence alone rather than confirming or deleting it — flagging it as unverified. Sion's E shredding YOUR armour is a reason to question the page's Plated Steelcaps line in report[8], but that is a build call the user should make, not one I invented. The packet's suspectName list is empty here; the mirror's note about a false-positive name refers to its own side.
